[[Mi Fai]] is a [[collector]] who stands near the eastern entrance to [[Kinya Province]].

==Locations==
* [[Shing Jea Island]]
** {{NPC location|Kinya Province}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Oh... those poor people in there. It breaks my heart to think of their suffering. Perhaps we can help by bringing their families word of what has happened to them. If you find any small, personal items on any of the plague's victims, bring them to me, and I will make certain that they are returned to the victims' families. It is not much, but perhaps it will bring them some peace. Return with 3 [[Forgotten Trinket Box]]es, and I shall give you this in return:"''

{{collector no armor trade dialogue|Forgotten Trinket Boxes}}

{{:Mi Fai/Collector armor}}

==Notes==
* In her dialogue she talks about the plague, but players do not get introduced to it until they reach [[Minister Cho's Estate]].
